rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, img_kernel=9, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-6, ONE-KNOB change vs iter-4 (the BEST base: SSIM 0.9732, PSNR 38.21 dB; img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005). REVERTED depth img_n_bf 5->3 (iter-5 img_n_bf=5 SATURATED/DROPPED to 0.9729 / 38.18 dB -- image-cascade depth is past its peak on breast, unlike demo which climbs to img_n_bf=7). Now probing a DIFFERENT axis on the saturation-point base. KNOB: image-domain BF spatial KERNEL size img_kernel 7 -> 9 (odd; the receptive field of each TrainableBilateralFilter2d in the image stack). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-4 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005 TIGHT, seed=42, proj sigmas at Wagner-abdomen solver defaults, proj_kernel=5 default). TRAJECTORY: iter-1 (defaults) 0.9720/38.17; iter-2 (proj sigmas tuned) 0.9680/37.90 -- proj HURT, reverted; iter-3 (img_sr 0.02->0.0005 TIGHT) 0.9723/38.19; iter-4 (img_n_bf 1->3) 0.9732/38.21 PEAK; iter-5 (img_n_bf 3->5) 0.9729/38.18 -- DEPTH SATURATED at 3. hr=0 throughout (all under 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline). FAILURE MODE: near the breast bilateral ceiling (~0.973 SSIM); the 12-param 3-deep edge-preserving image cascade lifted SSIM but PSNR stays pinned just below baseline -- depth (img_n_bf) and range-sigma (img_sr) axes are now exhausted. WHY THIS KNOB NOW: img_kernel is the IMAGE-domain RECEPTIVE-FIELD axis, NOT yet touched on this run (only depth img_n_bf and range img_sr were). This mirrors the Mayo bilateral receptive-field probe (Mayo iter-10 img_kernel). The design doc lists proj_kernel/img_kernel (default 5/7) as the spatial kernel size; at tight img_sr=0.0005 each BF is edge-preserving in the RANGE domain, so widening the SPATIAL kernel 7->9 pulls in more same-tissue neighbours as denoising support for the sparse-view streaks WITHOUT crossing fibroglandular edges (the range sigma still gates cross-edge averaging). HYPOTHESIS: a 9x9 image BF kernel at tight img_sr gives more spatial support to suppress 128-view streak noise edge-preservingly, lifting PSNR toward (ideally above) the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline and SSIM above iter-4 0.9732. If FLAT (SSIM within +-0.0005 of iter-4, PSNR within +-0.05 dB), breast bilateral N2I is CONFIRMED at its ~0.973 SSIM structural ceiling across all three image-BF axes (depth, range-sigma, receptive field) -- the BF inductive bias approaches but cannot beat a clean 128-view FBP. WALL: a 9x9 vs 7x7 image kernel raises the image-BF spatial cost ~(81/49)x (still a small fraction of the FBP-adjoint-dominated per-step cost); step budget unchanged (warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800); iter-4 (img_n_bf=3) ran 448 s, so well under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged.
